purpose: XGBoost on the same 87D symmetric feature set as the two neural networks, so all three models share one feature space and one site partition.
site_aggregation: index ranges from _shap_common.SITE_SLICES (M1 0:16, M2 16:29, M34_sym 29:35, global 35:87); identical to the neural-network scripts and independent of feature names
notes: The 96D model remains the production screening surrogate (28,560 predictions, M1_valence_electrons SHAP=0.52, five-descriptor R^2=0.87); this 87D run is an added control, not a replacement.
Two of the nine 96D-only columns (electron_affinity_M1, lattice_strain_M1) nominally belong to M1 but fell into the global bin under name-based grouping, biasing the 96D M1 share downward.
